title: Tip of the Day
body: The Character Manager holds more than you might think. Click any character's name to view their jump clones, contacts, kill logs, and other details all in one place.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Drowning in alts? Group your characters into named, color-coded Squads so a big roster stays organized the way you actually fly.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Search smarter, not harder. The character search understands filters like tag:, corp:, loc:, status:, and training: — try training: to instantly find every character with a skill in progress.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Make your roster yours. Create, rename, recolor, and reorder Tags from the Tags section in Settings, then apply them to any character.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Planning a new ship or doctrine? Build a Skill Plan and Pod shows the full training time, ordered queue, and completion date.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Already have a skill plan in EVE? Paste it straight in — Skill Plans import from EVE's clipboard text or a JSON file, and export back out the same way.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Which alt should fly it? Open the Skills Compare window to line your pilots up side by side and see who's closest to ready.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Squeeze more out of your training. Skill Plans suggest an attribute remap to shave time off long queues.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Watch your empire grow. The Wallet tab charts your net worth over time — assets, wallet, and a separate Liquid ISK line so you can see how much you can actually spend.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Lost track of your stuff? The Assets tab groups everything into a geographic tree — drill from region down to the exact station or structure holding an item.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Never undock short again. Set up a Stockpile with target quantities and Pod tracks how full it is across all your characters and corp hangars.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Restocking? Export any Stockpile's shortfall straight to an EVE multibuy list — paste it into the in-game window and buy exactly what you're missing.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Got a drawer full of abyssal modules? The Abyssals view lists each one's mutated stats and estimated value — filter by any stat range to find that perfect roll.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Small system drive? The Storage section in Settings lets you move Pod's database, logs, and image cache to any folder or drive you like.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Your data stays yours. Pod keeps everything in a local database on your machine — nothing about your characters lives on someone else's server.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Sending EVEmail from Pod? Recipient search is live — start typing a character, corp, or alliance name and pick from real results, no copy-pasting IDs.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Don't let your queue run dry. Pod shows each character's training ETA right on their card, so you know at a glance who needs attention.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Optimizing attributes? Skill Plan remaps account for the implants you're actually flying, so the suggested split matches your real clone.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Big hauler, small patience? The Assets list loads as you scroll and expands containers on demand, so even a huge inventory stays snappy.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Comparing buy lists? Stockpile multibuy export can show the full target or just the remaining shortfall — toggle whichever you need.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Fly on more than one machine? Point Pod's storage at a shared drive and your data follows you, with safe handoff between computers.

title: Tip of the Day
body: Portraits looking stale? Pod refreshes character portraits and corp logos automatically, so the faces in your roster stay current.
